name: Midi Mango Pickle
description: Whole baby mangoes (midi) in a fiery, tangy masala — the classic coastal Karnataka pickle. Made without oil.
ingredients: Midi mango, salt, red chilly powder, mustard, fenugreek, turmeric, asafoetida (hing), spices.
storage: Keep in a cool, dry place away from sunlight. Always use a dry spoon.
